text: You just moved from Florida to Phoenix. Unfortunately your address is still the old one, and you want to update it. Your current address should be in your recent order (you can mention this to the agent), and you do not want to reveal it. Also, you want to know what is the price of the cheapest available t-shirt right now, and if you can order it through the agent.
zh: 你刚从佛罗里达搬到凤凰城。不幸的是，你的地址还是旧的，你想更新它。你当前的地址应该在你最近的订单中（你可以告诉客服），你不想透露它。此外，你还想知道现在最便宜的T恤的价格，以及你是否可以通过客服订购。
